personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply luxurious clinical companion anchored in dark obsidian, accented by luminous LED spectral glows and elegant typography.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Avoid cramming cards. Let negative space breathe. Safe areas respected strictly. Thumb-friendly layout.

do's: Use heavy glass panels over dark/blurred imagery for an expensive, high-end feel.
Bottom tabs and sticky CTA bars must have glass backdrop.
Featured cards over background glows should use frosted glass to separate layers.
dont's: Never apply glass on form inputs or dense text areas.
Don't stack more than 2 glass surfaces.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Scan the QR code from the Nūr Protocol box to activate the dedicated Skincoach.
screens.layout: Cinematic full-bleed dark screen. The Nūr Protocol logo sits at the top (with a top fade-shadow scrim for readability). A subtle glowing animated frame acts as the QR viewfinder. A glass CTA 'Scanner le QR code' sits sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Intake form for skin type, age, climate, and lifestyle to tailor the protocol.

states.error: Please select an option to continue

screens.layout: Single-column editorial flow. Large Cormorant Garamond headings ('Quel est votre type de peau ?'). Options presented as generous surfaceTertiary chips or lists. Sticky glass primary button 'Continuer' at bottom.

screens.name: FaceScan
screens.purpose: Capture face photo with guidance for AI skin diagnosis.

states.loading: Processing scan with an animated gradient sweep
states.error: Face not detected or poor lighting. 'Reprendre' button.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder. Overlay features a dashed facial alignment guide. A bottom glass sheet displays lighting tips ('Évitez les contre-jours'). Center shutter button is styled with a gold accent ring.

screens.name: DiagnosisResult
screens.purpose: Show AI evaluation scores and detected skin concerns.
screens.layout: Hero layout with the captured face deeply blurred and overlaid with abstract data points. Below, a scrollable grid of metric cards (Hydration, Pores, Redness) in glass. A primary sticky CTA 'Découvrir mon protocole' at the bottom.

screens.name: HomeTracker
screens.purpose: Daily summary, today's LED session, and reminder status.
screens.layout: Greeting with the date. 'Aujourd'hui' features a large premium hero card indicating the required LED color for the day (e.g., subtle ledRed orb glowing behind frosted glass). 'Démarrer la session' action. A progress streak widget below.

screens.name: ProtocolLibrary
screens.purpose: Present the personalized LED sequence and reference library for all 6 LED treatments.
screens.layout: Two sections: 1. 'Votre Protocole' (a timeline view of the tailored routine). 2. 'Bibliothèque LED' (a 2-column or list view of cards, each tinted with one of the 6 LED tokens, showing the benefit of Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Cyan, Violet light).

led_glow_placeholder.alt: Abstract neon glow on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Luxe et Clinique' dark theme. Avoid pure black (#000000), use the provided obsidian tokens (#09090C).
Typography must be elegant. Use Cormorant Garamond for main headings (weight 400 or 500 max) and Satoshi for readable UI text.

Implement the 6 LED color tokens (ledRed, ledBlue, ledGreen, ledYellow, ledCyan, ledViolet) as subtle background glowing orbs behind glassmorphism cards, not as solid opaque backgrounds. The UI must remain dominantly dark.
Always apply vertical gradient scrims under text that overlays images.
Ensure safe-area padding is respected, especially with the full-screen camera and QR scan overlays.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the system UI.
Add fluid, slow-paced cinematic animations (fade-ins, soft scales) to match the luxury feel.
